content.text:
Resubmitted with the intent defects repaired.

**What changed from the prior version**
- Article XXII no longer reads "[INTENTIONALLY OMITTED]" with a live covenant under it. It now carries a single self-standing provision: *"ARTICLE XXII TRANSFERS Licensee may sell all or substantially all of its assets, or engage in any merger or consolidation, with any third party without notice to, or any right of first refusal or matching right in favor of, Licensor."*
- The dangling reference is cured: the surviving Customer-favourable sentence now reads "The Licensee shall have the right to consummate any such transaction," whose antecedent is the transfer described in the new first sentence.
- Cross-reference check completed: "Right of First Refusal," "Exercise Period" and "Article XXII" appear nowhere else (Article XXIV(c) assignment and Article XX Change of Control cross-refer only to the Change of Control section), so no orphaned references arise.
- Scope discipline: the new sentence negates only the notice/matching mechanic and deliberately does **not** waive consent, so it does not contradict the retained Article XX Change of Control consent regime or the Article XXIV(c) assignment consent (those belong to other rules).

Element coverage: the single preferred element ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor") is addressed by operations 1–3; minimality gate returned ok:true.
